stories.headline: WebAssembly Component Model Reaches 1.0, Unlocking Cross-Language Browser Plugins
stories.excerpt: The component model spec, finalized after four years of W3C work, lets independently compiled Wasm modules link at the type boundary without shared memory. Browser vendors plan to ship native support by year-end, opening the door to mixed-language web applications.
stories.licenceBasis: Hacker News public API — titles and links, discussion linked out

stories.headline: Edge Computing Surpasses 40 Percent of Web Traffic as Latency Demands Grow
stories.excerpt: Content delivery networks report that nearly half of all dynamic web requests now execute at edge nodes rather than origin servers. The shift is driven by real-time AI inference, personalization engines, and regulatory requirements for data locality.

stories.headline: Quantum Error Correction Crosses Below-Threshold Barrier on Superconducting Chip
stories.excerpt: A research team demonstrated logical qubit error rates lower than physical qubit error rates on a 72-qubit superconducting processor — crossing the key threshold that makes adding more qubits actually improve reliability rather than worsen it.
stories.licenceBasis: EurekAlert press release — redistribution with attribution permitted

stories.headline: ECB Advances Digital Euro to Preparation Phase, Sets 2028 Launch Window
stories.excerpt: The European Central Bank approved moving its central bank digital currency project from investigation to preparation, outlining a phased rollout that would give eurozone residents a digital wallet option backed directly by the central bank.

stories.headline: Great Green Wall Reaches 18 Percent Completion After Funding Surge
stories.excerpt: Africa's 8,000-km reforestation initiative across the Sahel has restored 18 million hectares of degraded land, according to the latest AU assessment. A $2.7 billion pledge from Gulf states and the EU has accelerated planting in Senegal, Niger, and Ethiopia.

stories.headline: Apple Patches Actively Exploited WebKit Zero-Day Affecting All Platforms
stories.excerpt: An emergency update addresses a type-confusion vulnerability in the WebKit rendering engine that was being exploited in targeted attacks. Apple confirmed the flaw allowed arbitrary code execution via specially crafted web content.

stories.headline: Ingenuity's Successor Completes First Powered Flight on Mars With 5x Range
stories.excerpt: NASA's next-generation Mars helicopter, carried by the Perseverance rover, flew 2.4 kilometers in a single sortie — five times the distance Ingenuity ever covered. The larger rotor blades and upgraded solar cells enable science-grade reconnaissance flights.

stories.headline: Satellite Network Pinpoints 200 Super-Emitter Methane Leaks in Real Time
stories.excerpt: A constellation of methane-tracking satellites now identifies and alerts operators about the largest leaks within hours of detection. The system has documented emissions from oil fields, landfills, and coal mines across 40 countries since going operational.

stories.headline: Blood Test Detects Alzheimer's Pathology 15 Years Before Symptom Onset in Large Trial
stories.excerpt: A multi-site study of 11,000 participants showed a plasma phospho-tau biomarker test achieved 92 percent accuracy in identifying brain amyloid accumulation, matching PET scan results at a fraction of the cost. Clinical deployment could begin within two years.

stories.headline: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Fines Target Non-Compliant Emotion-Detection Systems
stories.excerpt: European regulators issued their first penalties under the AI Act, targeting three workplace surveillance vendors whose emotion-recognition tools failed to meet transparency and consent requirements. The fines total €4.2 million.

stories.headline: Lithium Prices Stabilize After 18-Month Decline as EV Demand Catches Up With Supply
stories.excerpt: Spot lithium carbonate prices have traded in a narrow range for six consecutive weeks after falling 70 percent from their 2024 peak. Analysts attribute the floor to accelerating EV adoption in Southeast Asia and India offsetting slower growth in China.

stories.headline: Southern Ocean Carbon Sink Weakens for Third Consecutive Year, Observations Show
stories.excerpt: Autonomous floats deployed across the Southern Ocean reveal that the region's capacity to absorb atmospheric CO₂ has declined measurably since 2024. Stronger westerly winds are mixing carbon-rich deep water to the surface, partially offsetting the sink.
